Master Mini Games
You can achieve victory in various mini games.\nTry reaching one of the top ranks (place 1-3) for the best scores.

Compete in various games.
{color:#FFFFFF}These activities consist of 1 or 2-course Sprint, Bullet Hell, Jump Rope, Candy Rush, and Horizontal Sprint. One will be chosen at random.

{color:#9ec608}[Sprint Course 1], [Sprint Course 2], [Horizontal Sprint]
{color:#FFFFFF}- Run through an obstacle course to arrive at the finish line first.

{color:#9ec608}[Bullet Hell], [Jump Rope], [Lightning Runner]
{color:#FFFFFF}- Survive a maelstrom of bullets, lasers and range attacks.

{color:#9ec608}[Candy Rush]
{color:#FFFFFF}- Survive by eating candies.

{color:#9ec608}[Jumper Cables], [Lightning Runner], [Tile Drop]
{color:#FFFFFF}- Survive by dodging from obstacles and enemy attacks.
